summary: ExpenseBatch is a data entity and process responsible for managing batches of expenses, primarily grouped by department. The code implements CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) and includes search functionality, formatted batch numbering, and handles status codes and descriptions. It uses explicit stored procedures for all main actions.
purpose: To manage grouped sets of expenses (batches) in an organization, allowing users to search, add, update, and delete expense batches for reporting, workflow, and tracking purposes.

business_rules: A batch must have a DepartmentID, description, and date specified when created.
BatchNumberFormatted concatenates ID and StatusDescription for display.
StatusDescription uses alternative language if session indicates.
validations: Batch ID must be a valid integer (implicit by database).
Department ID must be provided and valid.
BatchDate must be a valid date.
StatusDescription field uses alternate language if session requires.
conditions: If session uses alternate language fields, fetch StatusDescriptionAlt else StatusDescription.
